title: 显示器数量
problem_statement_md:
在办公室里，每台电脑上都连接有2台显示器。

给点代码的第一行将输入电脑的数量，请计算并输出显示器的数量到控制台。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Math Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

In the office, 2 monitors are connected to each computer.
The first line of the given code takes the [b]number of computers[/b] as input.

[b]Task[/b]
Complete the code to calculate and output the number of monitors to the console.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
10

[b]Sample Output[/b]
20

[b]Hint[/b]
Since each computer has 2 monitors, simply multiply the count of the computers by 2.

[note]Use the [b]multiplication operator (*)[/b].[/note]
hint_md:
- 由于每台计算机有2台显示器，只需将计算机的数量乘以2。
- 使用乘法运算符`*`。

code_templates.template:
var computers = parseInt(readLine(), 10)

// 下面开始写代码
